stamp.dates_built: next 28 days from the build date
stamp.distance_method: ESTIMATED: straight lines between consecutive stops, multiplied by a road factor calibrated on Dublin's exact shape distances
stamp.block_method: INFERRED: per route, a bus that arrives at a terminal takes the next trip leaving that terminal (same stop or within 400 m) at least 5 minutes later; otherwise a new bus starts. No interlining between routes.

road_factor_calibration.source: Dublin Bus and Go-Ahead Ireland exact shape distances
